hero_subtitle:
A comprehensive one stop shop integrating AI-driven tools and strategic support,
for positive and resilient adaptation, at scale.
mission_text: We live in an unstable, burning, and polluted world, with limited resources — a world that is deteriorating our living conditions and increasing the vulnerability of businesses. We help model and implement adaptation strategies that foster long-term resilience for businesses and have a positive impact on the environment, notably by employing a regenerative approach.
theo_bio: Ecole Polytechnique and University of Cambridge (UK) graduate, with 4+ years experience in decarbonization and adaptation strategies for industrials and investors. Ex- BCG Climate
loraine_bio: Ecole Polytechnique and UCL (UK) data scientist, with 4+ years experience in environmental transition modelisation for industrials and investors. Ex- E-Cube data science department
maud_bio: 20+ years experience in helping companies' strategic transformation on digital & environmental challenges. Ex- P&G, Google & YouTube, WDNR co-founder & CEO, Climate House co-founder
maximilien_bio: 25+ years experience in helping companies adapt to environmental resiliency challenges. Ex- BeCitizen co-founder, Terrena ExCo and Axa Climate Regeneration Strategy Expert
louise_bio: Specialized in physical risks impact modelisation and financial quantification. Ex-founder Resilient
broad_network: And a broad network of trusted consultants, data scientists, designers and sector-specific experts partnering with us
newsletter_desc: Contact us to learn more about our solutions.
infra_support_1: Environmental risks modeling with potential financial losses assessment - risk = exposure x criticity x vulnerability
infra_support_2: Resilient and environmentally positive adaptation strategies definition - with ROIs calculation
infra_tools_1: Accelerated deployment of your adaptation & resilience strategies, site by site: creation of a numerical guide
resources_support_2: Climate vulnerability analysis for Tier 1 suppliers
resources_tools_1: Creation of a digital twin of your supply chain (rank 1 suppliers) to apply resiliency stress tests
resources_tools_2: Real-time control tower module - requiring supply chain digital twin
agri_tools_1: Creation of a resiliency simulator for the whole farming operation, analyzing local production and climate data at the plot level with unprecedented granularity
agri_tools_2: Resiliency assessment of entire farm and each plot in future climate scenarios to model future farm yields.
business_text: Reinventing supply and business models to meet environmental challenges and new market expectations
realestate_support_1: Climate risk assessment and adaptation strategies for real estate assets
realestate_support_2: Detailed vulnerability assessment downscaled at property level for value/insurability protection and prevention
realestate_tools_1: House-level detailed autodiagnostic for 'RGA' risk assessment and prevention
realestate_tools_2: Property-level risk mapping for asset/portfolio due-dilligences, and tailored vulnerability assessment for long-term insurability
